description: Declarative route manifest as single source of truth for published tunnel routes

requirements.title: Route manifest schema
requirements.description: routes.json defines an array of route entries, each with: subdomain, scenario name, expected UI port, enabled flag, and optional health endpoint path

requirements.title: Required route entry fields
requirements.description: Each route entry must include subdomain, scenario name, and expected UI port as required fields

requirements.title: Subdomain field validation
requirements.description: Subdomain must be a valid DNS label (lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens, max 63 chars)

requirements.title: Port number range check
requirements.description: Expected port must be in valid range (1-65535) and within scenario allocation ranges

requirements.title: Optional route entry fields
requirements.description: Route entries may include enabled flag (default true) and custom health endpoint path

requirements.title: Route manifest CRUD via API
requirements.description: API endpoints to list, add, update, and remove routes from the manifest. Changes are persisted to the database.

requirements.title: Route creation and listing
requirements.description: POST /api/v1/routes creates a new route entry; GET /api/v1/routes lists all routes

requirements.title: Route creation persists to database
requirements.description: New route entries are stored in PostgreSQL and survive server restarts

requirements.title: Route listing returns all entries
requirements.description: GET /api/v1/routes returns the full route manifest including enabled and disabled routes

requirements.title: Route update and deletion
requirements.description: PUT /api/v1/routes/{id} updates a route; DELETE /api/v1/routes/{id} removes it

requirements.title: Route manifest seeded from existing config
requirements.description: On first run, if no manifest exists, seed it from the current cloudflared config (local mode) or Cloudflare API (remote mode) to avoid blank-slate starts

requirements.title: Local config seeding
requirements.description: In local mode, parse existing config.yml ingress rules and create route entries for each

requirements.title: Remote API seeding
requirements.description: In remote mode, fetch ingress rules from Cloudflare API and create route entries

requirements.title: Route manifest validation
requirements.description: Validate manifest entries: no duplicate subdomains, no duplicate ports, all ports in valid range, scenario names are valid kebab-case identifiers

requirements.title: Uniqueness constraints
requirements.description: Reject duplicate subdomains and duplicate ports across route entries

requirements.title: Format constraints
requirements.description: Scenario names must be valid kebab-case identifiers matching existing scenario directories
